s1.text: Say a seller's factory calls their kids' toy certified.

s2.text: Covered kids' products need a CPC, general-use ones a GCC.

s3.text: Most wall-powered kids' toys have their own rule, part fifteen-oh-five.

s4.text: The package needs ratings, required warnings, and a date or code.

s5.text: Comment M and Z, we'll DM you the free CPSC finder.
